episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Kang In Goo goes to scope out the factory for his potential new business venture, but finds himself caught in a turf war. A local pastor offers his help.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Reluctant to hire a lawyer, Ingu considers a deal proposed by a secret agent. He expands his influence in prison, hoping to trick an ex-bodyguard.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: In Goo mediates a partnership between Jun Yo Hwan and Goo Sang Man. Yo Hwan does his due diligence before committing to the trade.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: A conflict at the border shifts the dynamics within Yo Hwan's inner circle. Sang Man proposes a different route to Korea.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Unable to convince Yoo Hwan to take the new route, In Goo improvises by coming up with a solution of his own. David Julio Park prepares a handoff.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Yoo Hwan throws a last-minute curveball in a plan that ensured In Goo's safety. Lee Sang Joon arrives at the airport as the crackdown on Yoo Hwan's empire begins.
